_about: Every public-domain Jonathan Edwards text the Word Hoard holds. CCEL ThML is clean and structured; Internet Archive items are OCR plain text (raw, unconverted). Gutenberg items are clean text. Order: CCEL > Gutenberg > Internet Archive. The Yale edition (1957-2008) is under copyright and lives only in the private shelf.

edwards-brainerd-life: The Life of Rev. David Brainerd, chiefly extracted from his diary

edwards-dwight-01: Works, Dwight ed. (1829-30), vol. 1: Dwight's Memoir
